description:
Configure Jitsi Meet to enforce a mandatory pre-join screen and require all participants to enter a display name. 

1. Edit '/home/ga/.jitsi-meet-cfg/web/custom-config.js' to enable 'prejoinPageEnabled' and 'requireDisplayName'.
2. Restart the Jitsi Meet web container (using docker compose in ~/jitsi).
3. Navigate to 'http://localhost:8080/PolicyTestRoom'.
4. Verify you CANNOT join without a name: Attempt to join with an empty name field. Take a screenshot of the disabled state named '~/Documents/evidence_blocked.png'.
5. Verify you CAN join with a name: Enter 'Verified User', join the meeting, and take a screenshot of the active meeting named '~/Documents/evidence_success.png'.
